messages.author: 28f7cf43544f2467
messages.subject: Preffered HTML/CSS Editor
parts:
Is there an HTML/CSS editor that anyone can recommend to make coding text/images within Shiny Apps a little easier?

I am looking for something that makes creating snippets of code (like below) that Shiny will recognize a little faster by allowing you to translate free form text/formatting into code snippets.

        tabPanel("About",
                p(style="text-align:justify",'This web application analyzes the provided mass spec data and provides a', strong('GO / NO-GO'), 'decision for the synthesis run batch. 
                  Follow the steps below to prepare the file used to import into this tool.'))

Any help/recommendations appreciated!

messages.author: b55e91b47a07d232
messages.subject: Re: Preffered HTML/CSS Editor
parts: In my Shiny-related work to-data I have been using 2 different IDE (RStudio and Eclipse with the StatET plugin), mainly because I have not yet decided which I like better. When I am working in RStudio I use HTMLKit to develop HTML and CSS, then copy the results into the R code. When working in Eclipse I just use the built-in HTML editor available in via the Eclipse Web-Tools plugin.
